settings.open-home.why: open Personal Settings on the Home tab

settings.stored-relations.why: turn Stored Relations on or off in Personal Settings > Home

do.js: proof.setSwitch('Enable stored relations', {{json with.on}}, { confirm: ['Reactivate without Migration', 'Deactivate', 'Activate and Migrate'] })

steps.why: flip Enable stored relations, taking Reactivate without Migration when offered
hold on the switch in its new state
